root_cause.text: AppArmor released the reference to i_private data (aa_ns, aa_proxy, aa_loaddata) at dentry removal time instead of at inode eviction, allowing a use-after-free when the filesystem accesses the freed data through a still-live inode.
root_cause.evidence: The patch removes explicit `aa_put_proxy`, `aa_put_ns`, and `aa_put_i_loaddata` calls from `__aafs_profile_rmdir`, `__aafs_ns_rmdir`, and `remove_rawdata_dents`, and introduces `aafs_evict` (set as `evict_inode` in `aafs_super_ops`) which calls `aa_put_common_ref` to release the i_private reference only during inode eviction.

agent_logs.evidence_points: The patch removes explicit `aa_put_proxy`, `aa_put_ns`, and `aa_put_i_loaddata` calls from `__aafs_profile_rmdir`, `__aafs_ns_rmdir`, and `remove_rawdata_dents`, and introduces `aafs_evict` (set as `evict_inode` in `aafs_super_ops`) which calls `aa_put_common_ref` to release the i_private reference only during inode eviction.

intent_record.intent_summary: Introduce a unified reference counting mechanism for AppArmor common refs used in the AppArmor filesystem and add proper cleanup on inode eviction.
intent_record.what: Added helper functions for reference counting on aa_common_ref structures (get_ns_common_ref, get_proxy_common_ref, get_loaddata_common_ref, aa_put_common_ref, aa_get_common_ref) and an inode eviction handler aafs_evict that releases the common ref stored in i_private and poisons the pointer.
intent_record.how: These functions provide a generic interface to get or put references on AppArmor namespace, proxy, and loaddata objects through a common ref structure with a type discriminator. The aafs_evict function ensures that when an inode is evicted, its associated common ref is properly released via aa_put_common_ref, preventing resource leaks and enabling use-after-free detection.

intent_record.how: Registers an evict_inode callback with the VFS, which will be called when an inode is evicted from the inode cache, allowing filesystem-specific cleanup before the inode is freed.

bic_trace_step.reason: The commit diff introduces a double refcount scheme to fix the use-after-free vulnerability. It replaces direct calls like `aa_put_loaddata` with `aa_put_i_loaddata` and `aa_put_profile_loaddata`, adds `aa_get_i_loaddata` before storing dentries and an `aa_put_i_loaddata` in `remove_rawdata_dents`, and changes `__aa_get_loaddata` to `aa_get_i_loaddata` in `seq_rawdata_open` and `rawdata_open` to properly refcount the rawdata inodes. These changes ensure the rawdata is freed only when all inode references are released, preventing the race condition. Thus the fix is present in this commit.
